reason: The contract requires result[s,t] = kv_cache[block_table[s, t//page_size], t%page_size], and explicitly states pages are non-contiguous and interleaved, with the block table free to map any sequence to any physical page. The kernel (line 15) computes physical = seq*max_blocks + logical_block and never loads from the BlockTable pointer at all, i.e. it hardcodes a contiguous per-sequence page layout. Probe t6 ran the real kernel on GPU with num_pages=16, page_size=4, head_dim=8, num_seqs=4, max_blocks=4, seq_len=8 and an int32 permuted block table [[7,3,14,2],[8,6,4,15],[12,1,5,0],[13,10,11,9]]: all 32/32 token rows mismatched the contract formula with max abs error 3.0669, while a contiguous identity table (block_table[s,b]=s*max_blocks+b) gave exactly 0.0 error — the exact signature of ignoring the block-table indirection. This is a required-formula violation on inputs the declared input domain admits.
